title: spec_body_amended event payload
$comment: Class: REQUIRES_SPEC_ID. Records a governed amendment to a spec's body via `caws specs amend`: blast_radius.modules, invariants, and (since CAWS-SPEC-AMEND-ACCEPTANCE-001) acceptance criteria — the given/when/then claims the close gate adjudicates. Distinct from spec_scope_amended, which covers scope.in/out/support only. Acceptance amendment carries the strictest coupling in the event vocabulary: rewriting a criterion's text invalidates the closure evidence recorded against the previous text, so set_acceptance co-occurs with reset_evidence unless the criterion had no evidence at all. On a CLOSED spec the writer permits filling a scaffolded entry but refuses removing or rewriting a substantive one, so this event can never record a retroactive rewrite of what a concluded spec claimed.

added_modules.description: blast_radius.modules entries added by this amendment (may be empty).

removed_modules.description: blast_radius.modules entries removed by this amendment (may be empty).

added_invariants.description: invariants entries added by this amendment (may be empty).

removed_invariants.description: invariants entries removed by this amendment (may be empty).

set_acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria whose given/when/then text this amendment rewrote in place, naming exactly which fields changed. The closure contract itself changed here, so any evidence recorded against the previous text was reset to unchecked in the same transaction — see reset_evidence.

added_acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria appended by this amendment, carried in full — a new claim is new information the event must assert.

removed_acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria removed by this amendment, carried in full — the removed claim is exactly what an auditor needs in order to judge the removal.

reset_evidence.description: Evidence entries reset to unchecked because their criterion's text was rewritten: the previous status is recorded so the audit shows exactly what proof was discarded and when. The close gate cannot proceed over these criteria until new evidence is recorded against the new text.

removed_evidence.description: Evidence entries deleted because their criterion was removed (an evidence entry whose criterion_id matches no declared acceptance[].id is rejected by semantic validation, so removal and evidence deletion are one transaction).

reason.description: Optional operator rationale supplied via --reason, recorded verbatim.

discharged_scaffold_fields.description: Fields whose scaffolded default was replaced by operator content in this amendment. This is the discriminator that makes an amendment on a closed spec legitimate: a closed spec may have a blank filled and never a claim rewritten.

previous_lifecycle_state.description: The lifecycle state of the amended spec. Recorded because the permitted operations differ by state, so a reader cannot judge the amendment without it.

resulting_modules.description: blast_radius.modules after the amendment. Schema-required non-empty, so the post-state is always assertable.
